charts.title: TOI-2000 c: orbits around TOI-2000
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2000's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2000 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 9.1270519 d

charts.title: TOI-2000 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2000 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (64, 65, 90) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 371188886, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
